title: Singapore expands role of WHO collaborating center
summary:
A partnership between the World Health Organization (WHO) and Singapore has been expanded to include risk assessment.

Singapore Food Agency’s (SFA) National Centre for Food Science (NCFS) has been a WHO collaborating center since 1992 focused on food contamination monitoring.
